landing.headline:
Your catalog,
classified.

landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need after the factory.

library.title: Product library

quote.title: Quote & COGS
quote.body: Unit price, real carrier name, shipping to your markets. Accept a quote in one click — no back and forth.

stock.title: Stock & restock

research.title: Research packs

economics.title: Unit economics
economics.body: ROAS break-even, multiplier, available profit per sale. Type a selling price — see every number update live.

notifications.title: Smart notifications
notifications.body: In-app, email, or WhatsApp. Quote ready, stock alert, lifecycle change — your rules, your channels.

quote.badge: Estimated — billed on real packed weight
quote.sectionTitle: A quote you can actually read.
quote.sectionBody: Four numbers. Real carrier name. No internal margin split. When rates move, you see the new COGS on your next visit.
quote.benefit1Body: One client price. Real carrier. No hidden tiers.
quote.benefit2Body: Grid updates cascade instantly. No surprises.
quote.benefit3Body: Accept and move on. We handle the rest.

workflow.title: From brief to stock in five steps.
workflow.sub: The entire product lifecycle — tracked, visible, and always up to date.

brief.title: Submit a brief

source.title: Voltship sources

sell.title: Sell & restock
sell.body: Monitor sales velocity, days left, and restock before you run out.

cogsMatrix.title: COGS 1–5 × market
cogsMatrix.lead: Cost of goods for an order of 1 to 5 units, per market — live grid, one parcel per order.
cogsMatrix.missingGrid: The rate grid is not active yet.
cogsMatrix.missingProduct: Price, weight and channel are filled in by Voltship — the matrix shows up after that.
cogsMatrix.formulaNote: COGS(n) = n × product price (+ commission) + packaging box if any + transport of one parcel of n × unit weight + packaging + handling once per order. The accepted quote stays the contractual reference for 1 unit.
cogsMatrix.roasNote: Break-even ROAS, then target ROAS at {margin}% margin, computed on the AOV (selling price × n) and the order COGS.
cogsMatrix.setNote: Sold as a set: 1 unit = the set of {count} pieces (price and weight of the whole set).
cogsMatrix.carrierNote: Under each market: the carrier shipping 1 unit. When a heavier parcel switches line, it is shown in the cell.
cogsMatrix.coveredHint: 2nd price: when the postcode is served by {line} (limited zones). Otherwise, the top price.

recurrence.noBuyers: no identified buyer in the cached Shopify orders.

carrier.lead: Pick the line that ships this product on each market — price and delay for 1 unit, live grid. The cheapest line is applied by default.

carrier.fallbackHint: Chosen line unavailable at this weight → cheapest applied
carrier.note: The chosen line drives the COGS, the matrix and the warehouse shipment. The accepted quote stays frozen.
carrier.readOnly: Only members of your workspace can change the line.
carrier.staffNote: Saved on the product: the client page, COGS, margin and ECCANG use this line.

composer.missingProduct: One of the products has no price, weight or category yet.
composer.missingRate: No shipping rate for this weight to {market}.
composer.missingGrid: The rate grid is not active yet.

settings.financialLead: Fees, target margins and safety buffer used for ROAS and restock alerts.

gmail.connectedBanner: Gmail inbox connected. The first sync (last 7 days) runs within 10 minutes.

gmail.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can connect or disconnect the inbox.
gmail.scopes: Requested access: read e-mails and send replies (gmail.modify). Customer addresses are never stored in clear text.

rateImport.title: Update rates with the assistant
rateImport.lead: Drop a carrier price list in any form — Claude turns it into a versioned grid, applies the Voltship margin rule, and you activate it after review.
rateImport.notConfigured: The rate assistant is not configured (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

step1.title: 1 · Price list
step1.lead: PDF, screenshot (JPEG/PNG), Excel matrix (.xlsx — one sheet per country × category, carriers as columns, weight in g as rows), CSV or pasted text — up to 3 files of 8 MB. RMB price lists per kg + fee or per weight bracket.
step1.hintPlaceholder: VIP grid of 24/09, Europe lines only…

paths.assistant: PDF, screenshot, pasted text or a carrier's own price list — the assistant reads and structures it, with a confidence score.
paths.matrix: your China_Carriers_Matrix file (.xlsx, one sheet per COUNTRY-CATEGORY, gram-by-gram weights) is read without AI: every carrier at once, 50 g brackets priced at the max gram. Auto-detected from the sheet names.

step1.matrixHelp: Forces the direct .xlsx read (no Claude). Otherwise the matrix is detected automatically when a sheet is named FRANCE-STANDARD, USA-ELECTRONICS…

step2.title: 2 · Review
step2.lead: Check every line, toggle the tax flag or exclude a line, adjust the margin rule, then activate.
step2.vatExtra: VAT on declared value billed extra — excluded by default

settings.title: Margin rule
settings.lead: price = cost € + max(cost € × margin %, min margin) + EU tax when not tax-inclusive, rounded to 0.05.
settings.handlingStep2: Extra handling for 2 units (€, every palier)
settings.handlingStep3: Extra handling for 3 units (€, every palier)
settings.handlingExtraUnit: Extra handling per unit above 3 (€, every palier)
settings.announcedAlert: Locked price alert threshold (min. margin per parcel, €)

comparison.title: Before / after — cheapest carrier
comparison.lead: Reference weights per destination and channel. Other carriers from the active grid stay in place; the imported carrier is replaced.
comparison.empty: No comparison yet — include at least one line.

activate.title: Activate the grid
activate.lead: Creates a new grid version containing these cells plus every other carrier of the active grid, activates it for every live quote, and logs the change. Accepted quotes stay frozen.
activate.confirmLow: I checked the low-confidence lines and want to activate anyway.
activate.confirm: Activate this grid now? Every live quote will use it.
activate.scheduleLabel: Or create now and activate on (China time)
activate.scheduleMissing: Choose the activation date and time.
activate.confirmSchedule: Create the grid now and activate it on {at} (China time)? The current grid stays live until then.
activate.scheduledDone: Grid {version} created ({cells} cells), activation scheduled on {at} (China time).

step2.allInclusive: All-inclusive matrix: every price is the final carrier cost per parcel — no tax or supplement is added and every line competes for the cheapest pick. IOSS mentions are informational.

margin.title: Voltship margin
margin.lead: What clients pay vs what it costs Voltship, over the last {days} days (parcels shipped through ECCANG).
margin.formula: Margin = (product + commission − factory price) + (client shipping − carrier cost − EU tax passed on) + (handling fee − real cost). FX at {fx} RMB/€; estimated FX gain vs {fxMarket}.

byClient.title: By client
byClient.lead: ECCANG parcels shipped over the window, priced with the active grid and the sourcing factory prices.
byClient.empty: No parcel shipped through ECCANG over the window. Per-product margins stay visible on each client page.

flags.carrier_cost_unknown: carrier cost unknown, grid imported before the assistant

clientCard.title: Voltship margin
clientCard.lead: Per product, 1 unit on the primary market, active grid. Factory prices come from sourcing (never visible to the client).
clientCard.weightedBySales: Total weighted by the last {days} days of sales.
clientCard.perUnit: No sales over {days} days: total per unit (1 per product).
clientCard.noGrid: No active grid: margins cannot be computed.

productPage.lead: Client price vs Voltship cost vs margin, per market and quantity (1 to 5 units in one parcel).
productPage.factoryMissing: Factory price missing in sourcing — the sourcing margin is not computed.

margin.settingsNote: Handling cost {handling} · FX {fx} RMB/€ · market rate {fxMarket} — editable in Pricing › Update rates › Margin rule.

byOrder.title: Per order
byOrder.lead: Parcels shipped through ECCANG in the last {days} days: what the client pays, what it costs Voltship and what we make on each order.
byOrder.leadEstimated: No ECCANG parcels yet: estimate on the Shopify orders of the last {days} days (one parcel per order, computed weight, grid carrier cost).
byOrder.unpriced: Not priced (incomplete product sheet or unknown SKU).

announced.title: Locked prices to watch
announced.lead: Each announced price re-checked on the live grid. When a carrier raises its prices the client price does not move and your margin shrinks: alert under {threshold} per parcel. After the « valid until » date the app falls back to the palier rule.

finance.title: Week-by-week result
finance.lead: Parcels shipped, client revenue, variable costs, fixed costs and result over the last {weeks} ISO weeks (Monday → Sunday, Paris time).
finance.formula: Result = (client revenue − variable costs) − fixed costs of the week. Monthly fixed costs × 12/52. Break-even = fixed costs ÷ average margin per parcel.

chart.title: Weekly result
chart.lead: Green: positive week. Rust: negative week. Hatched: estimated (Shopify orders, no ECCANG shipment).

table.title: Last {weeks} weeks
table.lead: Click a week to see the per-client split.

byClient.title: Per client
byClient.lead: Parcels valued with the active grid and the sourcing factory prices.

finance.caveat: Margin per parcel = Voltship margin engine (product + commission − factory, shipping − carrier − tax pass-through, handling fee − cost). Parcels without a factory price or carrier cost are partial. This is not accounting: VAT, real FX and payroll charges are not modelled.

costs.title: Fixed costs & adjustments
costs.lead: Rent, salaries, tools… prorated per week; one-off adjustments attached to a week.
costs.addLead: Monthly: × 12/52 per week. Weekly: as is. One-off: counted in the week of the start date.
costs.empty: No fixed cost yet. The result equals the gross margin.

adjustments.addLead: A refund, a bonus billed to a client, a damaged parcel… signed amount, attached to the week of the date.

admin.inviteEmailed: Invitation e-mailed: the client chooses their password.

todo.title: Products to complete
todo.lead: Every Shopify product of the connected stores that lacks Voltship data (product sheet, weight, client price, carrier, factory price). Mandatory = sold in the last 90 days: its orders are not priced until the sheet is complete. Optional = no sales yet, do it when you have time.
todo.create: Create the sheet and complete it →
todo.linkPlaceholder: …or link to an already quoted product
todo.footnote: ★ = title close to a product already quoted for this client. Within one store, Shopify pages sharing a SKU (duplicates, A/B tests) are grouped into one product; each store keeps its own products (different market and COGS). "Split" when a page is actually another item. Refreshed at every Shopify sync (10 min).
todo.pagesDetail: Show the grouped Shopify pages (same SKU, same store)
todo.splitHint: This page is a different item reusing the same SKU: it gets its own Voltship SKU and its own product.

orders.missingTable: The purchase_orders table does not exist yet: run migration 00019_purchase_orders.sql in Supabase.

status.to_warehouse: On the way to the warehouse

shopsPage.title: Shopify migration
shopsPage.lead: Connect sends you to Shopify’s install screen for the chosen store (OAuth). Once the merchant approves, the shop is saved and 90 days of orders plus the catalogue are imported. Clients can also connect their own store from Settings.
shopsPage.connected: Shop connected. Review the imported products below.
shopsPage.appsHelp: One “Custom distribution” app per client store (Dev Dashboard of the Voltship Partner organisation). Pick the client, paste the client ID and secret (leave them empty to only change the client): on install, the store is automatically linked to that client. The “Connect my store” button will use this app for this domain automatically.
shopsPage.label: Name (optional)
shopsPage.importHelp: Choose a store. Variants are grouped by product; products with 30 or more sales over 90 days (all variants combined) are pre-selected.
shopsPage.extraMarketsHelp: Countries the store also ships to (COGS computed for each).
shopsPage.francophoneHint: French store: usually also tick the French-speaking countries ({list}).

shopForms.importDone: {count, plural, =0 {No products imported.} one {# product imported.} other {# products imported.}}
shopForms.importButton: {count, plural, =0 {Import 0 products} one {Import # product} other {Import # products}}

alertsPage.title: Orders to review
alertsPage.lead: Unusual orders across all clients. The client sees the same alert and the same discussion thread in their space.

pricingPage.title: Pricing service
pricingPage.lead: Versioned shipping rates. Activating a version updates live COGS; accepted quotes stay frozen.
pricingPage.noVersions: Create a grid before adding rates.
pricingPage.importLead: Upload every weight bracket for one grid version. Matching cells are updated.
pricingPage.taxNotIncluded: Not tax-inclusive: EU parcel tax added
pricingPage.packagingLead: Weight of the bag / carton / label added automatically to every parcel, by the weight of its contents. Product sheets carry the product weight only; the client sees “product + packaging”.
pricingPage.scheduled: Scheduled activation: {grid} on {at} (China time). Prices switch at that time.
pricingPage.packagingLadderHint: Leave “no limit” empty on the last row. An empty row at the bottom adds a step. A product can have its own packaging on its sourcing sheet.

client.customHint: Rates manually adjusted for this client (the {tier} tier sets a {discount}% discount, {commission}% commission and {handling} € handling).
client.standardHint: Standard {tier} tier rates. Changing tier fills in the values; you can still adjust them before saving.

carrierRules.noActiveGrid: No active grid — activate a rate grid first.
carrierRules.forcedLead: Replaces the client’s choice on that market. Falls back to the cheapest allowed line when the forced line has no bracket at the parcel weight.

clientPage.whatsappLead: Number that receives WhatsApp notifications (quote ready with COGS 1 to 5, stock alerts, switch to Winning / Declining). Empty = no WhatsApp.
clientPage.pricingLead: Applied to the active shipping grid in every COGS calculation (quotes already accepted stay frozen).
clientPage.lifecycleLead: Thresholds used to classify this client’s products on every Shopify sync.
clientPage.carriersLead: Lines this client may use per product and per market (unchecked = hidden and never used), with a forced line per market if needed. Applied to every COGS; the ECCANG shipping rules must use the same line. Accepted quotes stay frozen.

eccangCard.title: Warehouse (ECCANG)
eccangCard.lead: One appKey / appToken pair per client (created in the ECCANG OMS). The token is encrypted and never sent back to the browser. Go-live: 8 October 2026.
eccangCard.notConfigured: ECCANG_API_HOST is not set on the server: calls are disabled.
eccangCard.enableLabel: Enable the ECCANG integration for this client
eccangCard.warehousePlaceholder: Test the connection to list warehouses
eccangCard.mapHelp: Key = Carrier or Carrier|Line as written in the rate grid (e.g. YunExpress|CHC), or default / default:FR. Value = code returned by getShippingMethod. Global table (all clients). Only used when the app pushes the orders itself (ECCANG_PUSH_ORDERS=1): by default ECCANG imports the Shopify orders and applies its own shipping rules.
eccangCard.callbackTitle: Callback URL to declare in the ECCANG OMS (订阅回调)
eccangCard.callbackHelp: Types to subscribe: order, receiving, stock. ECCANG verifies the URL with ?random=… (echoed back as is). Without a callback, the 15-minute cron does the same job.

achats.title: Purchasing & orders to ship
achats.lead: What to buy to ship the pending orders and cover {cover} days of sales after arrival, then the Shopify orders not shipped yet, shop by shop.

stats.unpriced: {count, plural, one {# product without factory price} other {# products without factory price}}

buy.title: To buy
buy.lead: Need = pieces of pending orders + daily sales (last {window} days) × (restock lead time + {cover} days). To buy = need − stock − what is already on the way.
buy.empty: No sales or pending orders over this period.
buy.howto: Stock = ECCANG stock (else the stock declared on the product). On the way = open supplier orders or inbounds announced in ECCANG. Lead time = production lead time of the product (7 days by default). Sets count their pieces. Urgent = stock does not cover the restock lead time.

ship.title: To ship, by shop
ship.lead: Non-cancelled Shopify orders placed since {since}, not marked shipped in Shopify yet.
ship.empty: No pending order over this period.
ship.howto: Status re-read from Shopify at each sync (full every night over 90 days). « In ECCANG » = received by the warehouse, not shipped yet; « Shipped by ECCANG » = left, tracking goes back to Shopify. « To check » = flagged order (0 €, promo abuse…).

skuFix.title: SKUs to fix
skuFix.lead: Shopify variants with no SKU, or with another item's SKU (duplicated pages). ECCANG matches products by SKU only. The proposed SKU is readable: country + product type + option number (e.g. FR-MAGNESIUM-COMPLEX-01, FR-BRACELETS-02), with no client name and no brand. It stays internal: carriers replace the label and declare the product under its customs name. Editable before writing. Past orders keep their old SKU.
skuFix.writeHint: Only ticked lines are written. Nothing is pre-ticked until a client is selected. Same item on several pages: give it the same SKU (pages with the same title already share it; otherwise copy it, e.g. the translator's existing SKU). “Another item's SKU” lines and service lines (insurance, shipping) are not ticked by default.
skuFix.pickClient: Pick a client to pre-tick their lines: only write for clients who agreed.
skuFix.service: Service line (not a product): leave it without a SKU.

trackingPage.title: Tracking → Shopify
trackingPage.lead: Import a tracking file (ours, ECCANG, carrier or previous agent): each order is marked shipped in the client's Shopify store with its tracking number and carrier. Orders already shipped are left untouched, so the same file can be sent again safely.
trackingPage.shopHint: Automatic: the order is looked up by its Shopify ID in every store of the client. Pick a store when the file only has order numbers (#14236) and the client has several stores.
trackingPage.fileHint: Recognised columns: Order Name (#14236) and/or Shopify Order ID, Tracking Number, Tracking Company (optional). Comma, semicolon or tab separated.

columns.order: order (Order Name or Shopify Order ID)

preview.tooMany: More than {max} lines: split the file.

trackingPage.notify: Send Shopify's shipping email to the end customer (with the tracking link).
trackingPage.consent: {client} agrees that Voltship marks their orders as shipped in their Shopify store.
trackingPage.allGood: Every order is marked shipped in Shopify.
trackingPage.noClients: No client has a connected Shopify store.

errors.consent: Tick the client's consent before sending.

linesPage.title: Carrier lines
linesPage.lead: The app picks the line of every parcel: the cheapest one that delivers the postcode. Here: parcels that left on another line than planned, and the postcode list of each line.
linesPage.missingTable: Run the 00023_line_routing.sql migration in Supabase to turn on the line check.
linesPage.checkDone: {checked} parcels checked · {moreExpensive} on a dearer line (+{extra} ¥)
linesPage.autoCarriers: Without a postcode list, only these carriers are used: {list}.
linesPage.howItWorks: The app does not change ECCANG: a parcel still without label on a dearer line is flagged here, to switch in ECCANG before packing.
linesPage.openHint: No label yet: switch before packing

stats.open: {count, plural, one {# still without label} other {# still without label}}

unmapped.title: ECCANG methods not linked to a line
unmapped.lead: These codes are missing from the carrier → ECCANG method map (client page → Warehouse). Add them so their parcels get checked.

table.title: Parcels to look at
table.lead: Biggest extra costs first. Carrier costs in RMB, internal to Voltship.
table.empty: No gap over the last 7 days.

coverage.title: Postcodes per line
coverage.lead: A line with a list only takes its codes (or every code but its codes). Huahan is only used once its list is imported.
coverage.only: {count, plural, one {# code delivered} other {# codes delivered}}
coverage.except: {count, plural, one {# code excluded} other {# codes excluded}}

form.saved: {count, plural, one {# code saved} other {# codes saved}}.

impersonate.banner: Viewing as {client}. Writes are audit-logged as you.

sourcer.soon: Oldest requests first. Complete the quote fields and send the client-ready COGS.

queue.intro: Oldest first. Fill the client-safe quote and keep supplier details internal.
queue.empty: No sourcing work matches these filters.

queue.zeroShown: Shopify products with no sale in 90 days shown.

product.currentUnitCost: Current unit cost at agent (€, client)

form.clientFieldsIntro: These values appear on the client product page.
form.clientPriceHint: Per unit, before the tier commission (added automatically).
form.skuHint: Empty = a Voltship SKU (VS-CLIENT-001) is assigned when the quote is sent. The client puts this SKU on his Shopify product so orders link automatically.
form.batteryInternal: Battery built into the device (rechargeable). Only these products can ship with Huahan 内电 to the US.
form.packPieces: Sold as a set — pieces per unit sold
form.packPiecesHint: 1 = sold alone. Set 2 if one Shopify unit = 2 pieces to ship (set of 2).
form.packPiecesSetHint: Set of {count}: 1 unit sold on Shopify = {count} pieces to pick at the warehouse (ECCANG).
form.setWeightHint: Weight of the whole set ({count} pcs), without packaging: it is added automatically.
form.setPriceHint: Price of the whole set ({count} pcs): what the client pays per unit sold.
form.setFactoryHint: Factory price of the whole set ({count} pcs).
form.clientNotePlaceholder: E.g. sold as a set of 2, engraving included; factory lead time 7 days…
form.clientNoteHint: Shown at the top of the client’s product page with its date. The client gets a notification for each new note. Internal notes (yellow box) stay private.
form.weightHint: Bare product, no packaging: packaging is added automatically (see below).
form.boxTitle: Packaging box (only if the product needs one)
form.boxIntro: Leave empty when there is no box. The box is packaging, not a product: it is billed to the client on a “Packaging (box)” line, at cost and without commission, per unit sold. Its weight is added to each unit of the parcel.
form.boxBilled: Billed €{eur} to the client per unit, no commission (rate {rate}).
form.packagingOverrideHint: Empty = automatic by parcel size (Pricing). Fill only if this product has special packaging.
form.customsIntro: Sent to ECCANG with the product and printed on carrier labels. Declared value: {value} USD for every product.
form.declaredNameEnHint: 50 characters max, generic name (not the brand)
form.dimensionsHint: The 3 dimensions also count for the shipping volumetric weight.
form.factoryPriceFirst: Fill this first: the client product price (€) is computed automatically.
form.clientPriceLinked: Computed from the factory price (¥ ÷ {rate}). Type another value to set it by hand.
form.boxEqualsFactory: ⚠ Same value as the factory price: probably a mistake. The box is billed on top of the product.
form.advancedHint: box, specific packaging, sold as a set — rarely used
form.customsPrefillHint: Click « Pre-fill » for the usual declared name, HS code and dimensions, then check.

announced.title: Prices announced to the client
announced.lead: Total per parcel (product + transport + handling, €) promised to the client. When a box is filled, the app bills exactly this price for that market and quantity, and the Voltship margin is computed on it. Empty = palier rule.

carrier.title: Carrier per market
carrier.lead: The line used for each market’s COGS — the one the client sees and the one to send to ECCANG. “Auto” = cheapest at the product weight; choosing a line fixes it for this product (the client sees the same choice).
carrier.missingProduct: Fill in client price, weight and shipping channel to see the carriers.

catalog.title: Products
catalog.intro: Every product of every client and shop. Per market: COGS for 1 unit and the carrier that ships it. Click a product to edit it.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search a product, SKU, client, shop…
catalog.carrierLegend: Carrier: “auto” = cheapest at the product weight, “chosen” = line chosen by the client or the team, “forced” = the client’s Voltship rule.

upsells.title: Upsells
upsells.lead: Products bought with this one in the same order (pouch, case, gift…). Added automatically as soon as one sale has both: the cheaper of the pair becomes the upsell of the dearer one. They must always be in stock with the product. The client sees them on the product page (“Frequently bought together”) and builds the parcel. A removed upsell does not come back.
upsells.suggestionsTitle: Other products bought with this one (30 days, {orders} orders)
upsells.noOrders: No Shopify order of this product in 30 days.
upsells.noSuggestion: No other product bought in the same orders.
upsells.noProduct: SKU not created as a product yet
upsells.pick: Pick a product of the client…
upsells.sourceAuto: auto · {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} together

live.noLine: No line covers this weight on this market.
live.hint: Updated as you type, same grid and rules as the matrix. Remember to save.

orders.title: My orders
orders.lead: The production and restock orders Voltship places for you, with their progress.
orders.leadOpen: {count} order(s) in progress at our factories. Follow every step here until they reach the warehouse.
orders.empty: No orders yet. When Voltship launches a production run for you, it shows up here.

price_anomaly.title: Abnormal price
price_anomaly.help: Many items for almost nothing paid (less than €1 per item). Order removed from sales in the meantime.

zero_total.title: €0 order
zero_total.help: The customer paid nothing: gift, influencer, test… or a 100% discount code.

discount_abuse.title: Large discount
discount_abuse.help: At least 60% off the products: discount code shared or misconfigured?

quantity_spike.title: Unusual quantity
quantity_spike.help: 10 or more items in a single order.

gift_abuse.title: Extra free gift
gift_abuse.help: Free item taken 2 times or more, or more free items than paid products: the gift quantity should be locked to 1 in the shop. We ship what the offer gives.
